build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: In combat, the player has a hand of 7 letter tiles drawn from their pool. Tiles can be dragged onto a spelling bar to form a word. Submitting a valid word deals damage proportional to word length. Invalid words fizzle and waste the turn. Score 0 if no word-forming mechanic exists.

Special letter combinations trigger elemental bonus effects — specific substrings within words activate fire, ice, heal, or other effects shown as visual icons. At least 3 distinct elemental triggers exist. Score 0 if no bonus effects exist.

Enemies have visible health and telegraph their next attack with a countdown number showing damage. The player must deal enough damage before the countdown reaches zero. Score 0 if enemies have no visible health or attack telegraph.

Between encounters, the player can add new letter tiles to their pool, upgrade existing tiles (adding bonus effects), or remove weak tiles. These choices shape future combat capability. Score 0 if no tile management exists between encounters.
A map shows branching paths with combat nodes, rest nodes (heal), and shop nodes (buy/sell tiles). The player chooses their route through the dungeon. Score 0 if no map or path choice exists.

At least 6 distinct enemy types exist with different health pools, attack patterns, and weaknesses to specific elements. Different enemies require different word strategies. Score 0 if fewer than 3 enemy types exist.

Letter tiles have rarity tiers with bonus effects — golden vowels score double, enchanted consonants trigger effects, cursed tiles penalize if unused. At least 5 special tile variants exist. Score 0 if all tiles are identical.

The dungeon has at least 3 floors with increasing difficulty, culminating in a boss with high health requiring multiple strong words to defeat. Floor transitions are visible on the map. Score 0 if only one floor exists.

Shops sell specific tiles and tile upgrades for gold earned from combat. Rest nodes heal a portion of health. At least 2 non-combat node types with distinct interactions exist. Score 0 if no non-combat nodes exist.
A death/victory screen shows floor reached, longest word cast, total damage dealt, tiles collected, and elemental triggers activated. Score 0 if no results exist.
A styled title screen shows letter tiles arranged into a spell effect with the game name. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.
The game flow connects title -> map -> combat -> rewards -> next node without restarting. Score 0 if transitions are missing.
During combat, the letter hand, spelling bar, enemy health, attack countdown, elemental triggers, and player health are all clearly visible and non-overlapping. Score 0 if no combat UI exists.
Readability at 1280x720 is strong: letter tiles are large and legible, enemies are distinct, elemental effects are clear, and the map is navigable. Score 0 if elements blend together.

The art direction is coherent across title, map, combat, tiles, enemies, and UI — a consistent magical/arcane word-casting aesthetic. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.
Letter tiles have polished visual design with distinct styling for special tiles. Enemies have illustrated sprites. The map has themed node art. Score 0 if tiles are plain text on white squares.

HUD and UI chrome: spelling bar, health displays, map interface, shop screens, and result displays use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: tiles snap satisfyingly onto the spelling bar, valid words produce a casting animation, elemental effects have particle bursts, enemies react to damage, and invalid words fizzle with a visual effect. Score 0 if all state changes snap silently.
